issues_detected.description: Ethical-review entries identify contacts without a review outcome or documented determination. The tissue-culture deidentification rationale is not accompanied by comprehensive privacy safeguards, reidentification-risk assessment or data-protection impacts.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document the applicable review or non-human-subject determination, donor-consent provenance or its applicability, privacy safeguards and risk assessment. Explain which protection areas do not apply to the cell-line setting.

issues_detected.description: Detailed licensing, IP restrictions and a governance contact are present, but an explicit confidentiality classification and sufficiently complete applicable compliance assessment are not supplied.
issues_detected.recommendation: State the confidentiality classification and applicable regulatory obligations or documented reasons they do not apply, keeping access conditions distinct from reuse licensing.

issues_detected.description: Named tools and conceptual workflows lack software versions and comprehensive processing details for the released data. Annotation-quality, cleaning and imputation applicability are not documented.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide release-specific software versions, executable workflow references, inputs and outputs, and quality-control procedures. State whether cleaning or imputation was performed and preserve the distinction between released data processing and future map construction.

issues_detected.description: Collection mechanisms and two collecting laboratories are described, but collection timeframes, complete collector coverage and raw-source protocols are missing.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document acquisition windows, responsible laboratories for each modality, protocol identifiers and raw-data sources. Keep collection dates separate from publication and grant dates.

issues_detected.description: Multiple references are documented, but the only formal dataset citation identifies the June 2026 resource. There is no formal citation for the evaluated root dataset series.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide a recommended citation that explicitly identifies the root series by title and authors or publishing organization, while retaining the existing release-specific citation.

issues_detected.description: Cell-line donor demographics and experimental subpopulations are described, but explicit selection and inclusion/exclusion criteria are missing.
issues_detected.recommendation: Describe how cell lines, differentiation states, treatments and target genes or proteins were selected, including inclusion/exclusion criteria and resulting coverage limits.

issues_detected.description: Repository URLs and formats provide a general acquisition route, but current authentication, registration, agreement and embargo-access requirements are not fully specified. The cited Code of Conduct concerns a historical event.
issues_detected.recommendation: State current access tiers and authorization steps for each release or modality, including how embargoed data become accessible and whether registration or an agreement is required.

issues_detected.description: The record provides use restrictions and a population-coverage limitation, but lacks comprehensive social-impact analysis, mitigation strategies, standard bias categorization and fairness analysis.
issues_detected.recommendation: Categorize documented coverage biases, analyze their effects on intended AI and functional-genomics uses, and document foreseeable harms, discouraged uses and concrete mitigation strategies.

issues_detected.description: Version history, checksums, packaging descriptions and provenance-graph filenames do not expose complete entity-activity-agent relationships, processing lineage and derivation paths for the released data.
issues_detected.recommendation: Include or summarize the actual lineage relationships linking identified raw inputs, processing activities, responsible agents and released outputs, with stable references to the provenance representations.

issues_detected.description: The record reports a conflict between the project's June 17, 2025 listing date for the June 2026 release and the Dataverse publication date of June 17, 2026. It explicitly selects the Dataverse date and uses it consistently.
issues_detected.recommendation: Retain the source-specific discrepancy and explicit date-selection rationale in future versions.

semantic_insights: The root explicitly describes an ongoing dataset series, making it possible to distinguish series metadata from individual release identifiers and citations.
Source caveats preserve uncertainty instead of silently merging undated website metrics, historical preprint statements and current release metadata.
Descriptions of computed-map processing and labeling explicitly acknowledge that computed maps are absent from the June 2026 release.
Licensing, commercial-use restrictions and separate commercial-license negotiations are mutually coherent.
Preservation documentation combines a named institutional repository with an explicit funding commitment and governance contacts.
The related U2OS publication is not represented as confirmed use of the CM4AI releases.
The documented CVCL identifiers concern cell lines; the rubric's SCR_/AB_ patterns do not cover that entity namespace.
